BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription:
Frequency of services: 
• Root canals and retreatment, apicoectomy, clinical crown lenghtening-once per tooth per lifetime

• Gingivectomy, gingivoplasty, gingival flap procedure, osseous surgery, periodontal scaling and root planning - once per quadrant per 3 years
• Full mouth debridement - once per 3 years
• Clinical crown lengthening-hard tissue - 1 per permanent tooth per lifetime

• Complete or immediate denture - 1 per 5 years
•  Adjustment of dentures - 2 per year after 6 months of initial placement
• Repair dentures and replace/add teeth - once per tooth per year
• Rebase or reline dentures - 1 per 3 years after 6 months of initial placement
• Tissue conditioning

• Implants - one per 5 years per tooth
• Re-cement implants - once every 2 years after 6 months of initial placement

• Partial denture - one every 5 years
• Re-cement or re-bond fixed partial denture repair, partial fixed dentures - once every 2 years after 6 months of initial placement

•	Periodic oral exams, Extensive oral exam – problem focused, Re-Evaluation – limited problem focused – two per calendar year
•	Limited Oral Exam – 3 per calendar Year
•	Comprehensive Oral Exam or Comprehensive Periodontal Exam – One per 3 years per provider or location

•	Intraoral or Intraoral Tomosynthesis complete series of radiographic images, one set of vertical bitewing-7 to 8 films, panoramic radiographic image- one every 3 years
•	Intraoral-occlusal radiographic image-two every 2 years
